text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Getting to run the Tenno Sho (Spring) with 
Mejiro McQueen proved to be an 
irreplaceable experience for Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later. In an interview, Ikuno Dictus 
stated that her next goals would be the 
Yasuda Kinen and the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Powering through a grueling rotation to 
prove the strength of her "management 
skills" through results— there wasn't the 
slightest flicker of doubt in her resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next Yasuda Kinen is a 1,600m race. 
Transitioning from 3,200m training 
required the utmost caution.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, with the management of the 
Trainer and Ikuno Dictus, it wouldn't pose 
an issue. Preparations for the Yasuda 
Kinen proceeded steadily.
